plugins.name: ringcentral
plugins.description: Work with your RingCentral phone and Team Chat (Glip) account from Claude: check calls, voicemail, SMS, and faxes, look up colleagues, read or post/edit Team Chat messages, and manage Team Chat tasks, notes, events, teams, webhooks, and Adaptive Cards.

skills.name: call-followup-email
skills.description: Turns a recent RingEX phone call into a drafted (and optionally sent) follow-up email. Pulls the call from the user's RingEX call history, resolves who was on the other end and their email address, drafts a follow-up that references the call (using the AI call summary/insight when one exists), and sends it through whatever email tool is actually available — or hands back a ready-to-send draft if none is connected. Use this whenever the user wants to follow up on a phone call by email — phrases like "email them about that call", "send a follow-up to the person I just talked to", "draft a recap for my call with [name]", "I told a customer I'd send them something after we hung up", or "can you write a follow-up for my 2pm call" — even if they don't mention RingCentral, call history, or name a specific email tool. Do not use this for drafting emails unrelated to a phone call, or for logging/summarizing a call without producing an email (that's ringex-calls or ringex-meetings).
headings: Step 2: Resolve the other party and their email
Step 4: Find a way to actually send it
Known limitations (as of when this was written)
skills.description_zh: 从用户 RingEX 通话历史定位近期电话，识别对方及邮箱，并根据通话摘要或洞察起草跟进邮件；有可用邮件工具时可发送，否则交付待发送草稿。适用于电话后续跟进，不用于无关邮件或仅记录通话。

skills.name: call-recap
skills.description: Finds a specific recent call in the authenticated RingEX Phone user's own call history and recaps it with AI notes, transcript excerpts, and whether it was recorded. Use when the user asks to recap a call, summarize what was discussed, check if a call was recorded, or find a call about a specific topic or person.
skills.description_zh: 在已认证 RingEX Phone 用户自己的近期通话历史中定位特定电话，结合 AI 笔记、转录片段和是否录音进行回顾，支持按主题或人员查找。

skills.name: colleague-lookup
skills.description: Looks up a colleague by name, department, job title, or phone number across the company directory and the authenticated RingEX Phone user's personal contacts, disambiguating when more than one match is found. Use when the user asks for someone's extension, title, department, or availability, or wants to find a colleague in the directory or their own contacts.
skills.description_zh: 按姓名、部门、职位或电话号码搜索公司目录和当前 RingEX Phone 用户的个人联系人，有多个匹配时消歧；用于查询分机、职务、部门或可用状态。

skills.name: communications-brief
skills.description: Produces a RingEX Phone communications brief from recent calls, SMS, voicemail, contacts, presence, and message-store data, over a time window the user chooses (last 24 hours, last 3 days, last week, or a custom range). Use when the user asks for a communications digest or brief, a daily digest, morning briefing, catch-up report, missed communications, unresolved calls or texts, voicemail follow-up, or what to work on today. Always asks the user up front how far back to look rather than assuming a fixed window, and on a Monday 24-hour lookback, checks whether the weekend or a recent holiday should be folded in too.
skills.description_zh: 汇总 RingEX 电话、短信、语音信箱、联系人、在线状态与消息存储数据，生成通信简报、遗漏事项和待跟进清单；先询问用户回看时间范围，周一回看 24 小时时额外确认是否纳入周末或近期假日。

skills.name: fax-inbox
skills.description: Presents the authenticated RingEX Phone user's fax inbox as a clickable list of recent faxes, then reads back the selected fax's sender, time, and cover-page text when available. Excludes SMS and voicemail, and cannot retrieve the fax document body itself. Use when the user asks to see their faxes, check for a new fax, or find out who sent a fax.
skills.description_zh: 将已认证 RingEX Phone 用户的近期传真列为可点击收件箱，读取所选传真的发件人、时间及可用封面文字；不包含短信或语音信箱，也不能获取传真正文。

skills.name: manage-adaptive-cards
skills.description: Composes, posts, updates, and deletes RingCentral Team Chat Adaptive Cards for the authenticated user within the supported contract (version 1.3, Action.OpenUrl and Action.Submit only), refusing anything outside it rather than silently downgrading. Use to build a status card, a link card, or an approval/choice card in a chat — not for plain text posts, unsupported card actions, or team/task management.
skills.description_zh: 为已认证用户编写、发布、更新或删除 RingCentral Team Chat 自适应卡片，用于状态、链接或审批选择；仅支持版本 1.3 的 Action.OpenUrl 和 Action.Submit，超出范围时拒绝，不静默降级。

skills.name: manage-events
skills.description: Creates, finds, updates, or deletes RingCentral Team Chat events on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user, resolving the destination chat before writing. Use when the user wants to schedule an event in a channel, see what events are coming up in a chat, change an event's time or details, or cancel/delete an event — not for tasks, notes, or Outlook/Google calendar events.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户创建、查找、更新或删除 Team Chat 事件，写入前确认目标聊天；用于频道活动安排及取消，不用于任务、笔记或 Outlook、Google 日历事件。

skills.name: manage-notes
skills.description: Creates, finds, updates, publishes, locks/unlocks, or deletes RingCentral Team Chat notes on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user, resolving the destination chat before writing. Use when the user wants to create a note, draft or edit a note in a channel, publish a note, lock or unlock one, or delete a note — not for tasks, events, or plain posts (those have their own skills).
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户创建、查找、修改、发布、锁定解锁或删除 Team Chat 笔记，写入前确认目标聊天；任务、事件和普通消息使用各自技能。

skills.name: manage-tasks
skills.description: Creates, finds, updates, completes/reopens, or deletes RingCentral Team Chat tasks on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user, resolving the destination chat and any assignees before writing and verifying completion state after it. Use when the user wants to create a task, assign a task, see what tasks are in a chat/channel, change a task's due date or assignee, mark a task done, reopen a task, or delete a task — not for Jira, monday.com, or other non-RingCentral task systems.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户管理 Team Chat 任务，支持创建、查询、修改、完成、重开或删除；写入前明确聊天和负责人，写入后核验完成状态，不用于其他任务平台。

skills.name: manage-teams
skills.description: Creates, updates, archives/unarchives, or deletes RingCentral Team Chat teams, manages membership and favorites, and updates the company Everyone chat, on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user — with explicit confirmation before anything destructive. Use when the user wants to create a team, add or remove members, join or leave a team, archive or delete one, favorite/unfavorite a chat, or update the company-wide Everyone chat — not for posting, tasks, notes, or events.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户创建、修改、归档恢复或删除团队，管理成员与收藏并更新全公司 Everyone 聊天；破坏性操作前明确确认，不用于消息、任务、笔记或事件。

skills.name: manage-webhooks
skills.description: Creates, activates, suspends, or deletes RingCentral Team Chat incoming webhooks for a group, on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user, with explicit confirmation before suspending or deleting one. Use when the user wants to set up a webhook to post into a channel from an external system, pause or resume one, or remove one — not for Adaptive Cards, posts, or Team Chat's own outbound app integrations.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户创建、启用、暂停或删除群组入站 webhook，使外部系统向频道发消息；暂停和删除前明确确认，不用于卡片、普通发帖或出站应用集成。

skills.name: post-to-chat
skills.description: Sends, edits, or deletes a RingCentral Team Chat post — to a resolved person or a known chat/channel, including thread replies and file/image attachments — on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Chat user, with destination resolution and a mandatory preview/confirm step before any write. Use when the user asks to post in a channel, message someone on Team Chat/Glip, reply in a thread, attach a file, or edit or delete an existing post — not for SMS/text messages.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Chat 用户向已明确的人员或聊天频道发送、编辑或删除消息，支持线程回复和文件图片附件；任何写入前须解析目标并预览确认，不用于短信。

skills.name: read-team-chat
skills.description: Lets the authenticated RingEX Chat user browse recent Team Chat chats and read a selected one as a formatted stream of posts, notes, tasks, or events, or jump straight to a named channel/person and catch up on what's new there. Also resolves a colleague by name, email, extension, or phone number. Read-only. Use when the user wants to catch up on Team Chat/Glip, see what's new in a channel, review recent posts/notes/tasks/events, read a specific conversation, or find someone in the directory.
skills.description_zh: 只读浏览 RingCentral Team Chat 近期聊天及选定对话中的帖子、笔记、任务和事件，或直接查看指定频道与人员的新内容；可按姓名、邮箱、分机或电话号码查找同事。

skills.name: send-sms
skills.description: Sends a single person-to-person SMS on behalf of the authenticated RingEX Phone user, resolving the recipient, disambiguating the sending number, and confirming the exact message before sending. Use when the user asks to text someone, send an SMS, message a phone number, or reply to a text via RingEX Phone.
skills.description_zh: 代表已认证 RingEX Phone 用户发送单条个人间短信，先明确接收者及发送号码，并在发送前确认准确消息内容；支持主动短信和回复。

skills.name: sms-inbox
skills.description: Presents the authenticated RingEX Phone user's SMS and MMS inbox as a clickable list of recent conversations, then renders the selected conversation as a formatted text-message stream. Excludes voicemail and fax. Use when the user asks to see their texts, SMS inbox, message threads, who they've been texting, or to open a text conversation with someone.
skills.description_zh: 将已认证 RingEX Phone 用户的近期 SMS、MMS 对话列为可点击列表，并显示所选线程的格式化短信内容；不包含语音信箱或传真。

skills.name: voicemail-inbox
skills.description: Presents the authenticated RingEX Phone user's voicemail inbox as a clickable list of recent messages, then reads back the selected voicemail's caller, time, and verified transcription when available. Excludes SMS and fax. Use when the user asks to see their voicemails, check for new voicemail, read a voicemail transcript, or catch up on missed voicemail.
skills.description_zh: 列出已认证 RingEX Phone 用户的近期语音信箱，读取所选留言的来电者、时间和可用的已核验转录；适用于新留言检查与遗漏跟进，不包含短信或传真。
